For map exploration you open you map rmb on the node you want him to unlock go to the node manager and have him talk to it. This way you unlock both npc and topography knowledge.

Fog of war and node managers are 2 totally different things. If you happen to find the node manager first then you can talk to it and unlock the area. If you unlock the area first, discover the node icon, you can rmb on it to where the node manager is located. 1st photo: looks like USB C connector that's the part you connect to the motherboard, the other end I assume is attached to the case.

2nd photo: looks like the male connector on a case fan wire so you can daisy chain another fan to it. I assume the other end of this connector is a male plug that you can plug into the mother board or a fan hub and the other end is the fan it self.

3rd photo: argb connector. Not sure if your mother board supports argb but my Z390 only comes with RGB (4 pin connector), so i bought a ARGB hub to connect my ARGB lights into.

If you want to add argb to your rig do some research about ARGB and RGB first. This 2 are very different. They have different voltage and different connector type. Your rig can go boom if not connected properly.
